He is the former assistant to an entomologistTreadly: "''I was once the assistant to a world renowned entomologist. Now I'm a Pioneer Scout leader.''"
([[D01C Stings LeaderTreadly.txt#36|Treadly's dialogue]]) who can create [[insect repellent]] for new scouts if they bring him the appropriate ingredients. ==Interactions with the player character== ===Interactions overview=== {{Interactions FO76 |essential =yes |temp companion = |perm companion = |perk = |wares = |caps = |max condition = |heal = |cure addiction = |cure radiation = |rent = |items modified = |quests started =*[[Stings and Things]] |quests involved = }} ===Other interactions=== Meeting up with Treadly at the [[Dolly Sods Wilderness]] in [[The Mire]] triggers the quest "[[Stings and Things]]" as part of the requirements to complete "[[The Order of the Tadpole]]" and be promoted to Possum in the Pioneer Scouts. Doing so unlocks the ability to craft [[insect repellent]] at a [[Chemistry station (Fallout 76)|chemistry station]]. ==Inventory== {{Inventory |apparel = |weapon = |otheritem = |ondeath = }} ==Appearances== Scout Leader Treadly appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]'', introduced in the ''[[Wild Appalachia]]'' [[Fallout 76 updates|update]]. ==References== {{References}} [[Category:Wild Appalachia robots and computers]] [[Category:Mister Handy characters]] [[Category:Pioneer Scouts characters]] [[ru:Старший скаут Трэдли]]

Arms and armament awaiting inspection, sir!|sound=Flintlock 003a28ab_1.ogg}} '''Flintlock (GM-04)'''[[The Whitespring Resort terminal entries#Week of 10/11/77|The Whitespring Resort terminal entries; Maintenance room terminal, Maintenance Logs; Week of 10/11/77]] is a [[Mister Gutsy (Fallout 76)|Mister Gutsy]] serving as a [[Fallout 76 vendors|vendor]] at [[the Whitespring Resort]] in [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== Flintlock is a Mister Gutsy and one of the robotic vendors at the Whitespring Resort. He resides in the Black Powder store of the Whitespring's mall area, and even though he is not in a military camp, he still retains his drill sergeant-like attitude. '''Juliette''' is a woman working at the [[Mountainside Bed & Breakfast]] in [[Appalachia]].

==Background==
Juliette presents herself as the caretaker of the bed & breakfast. She will offer anyone who comes along, including the [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dweller]], a bed to sleep in and breakfast the next morning (cooked by her husband, [[Hubert (Wastelanders)|Hubert]]) for the low cost of 5 caps.

===Other interactions===
Juliet will offer the [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dwellers]] of [[Vault 76]] a place to stay for 5 caps. If a [[Perception (Fallout 76)|Perception]] check of 12 is passed, she will reveal that she and her husband are being forced to work by a group of [[Cannibal (Wastelanders)|cannibals]] and explains they are hiding in the basement, where they can be killed. She will cower during and after the fight.

If the room is rented and the Perception check is not passed, the player character may go to sleep in the bed upstairs. They will be woken up in the middle of the night by whispers from the cannibals waiting in the next room. From there, a fight will ensue.

A Mister Handy playing the role of the chief of security in a simulation [[vault]], Robinson provides the [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dweller]] seeking to pass the exam mandated by [[Professor-bot]] with the general overview of the situation.
